title: I do not understand: help phrases

sections.title: Say it when you are lost
sections.content: Use *Nem értem.* (I do not understand it.) when you have not understood. You know *Értem* and *Nem értem* from the first units; now put them to work. Add what you need: *Lassabban, légy szíves.* (More slowly, please.) *Még egyszer, légy szíves.* (Once more, please.) A friend can also say *Megismételnéd?* (Could you repeat it?).

sections.title: Asking for help
sections.content: *Segít* means "helps". Ask a friend *Segítesz?* (Can you help me?) and answer *Persze, segítek.* (Of course, I will help.) To offer help, use the question you know: *Segíthetek?*
*Nem értem* is a whole sentence, so say it alone and then ask for help. In Hungarian you may soften it with *Bocsánat*: *Bocsánat, nem értem.*
